use default

within(x: double, y: double, centre: double, radius: double) -> bool =>
    x * x + (y - centre) * (y - centre) <= radius * radius

symbol(x: double, y: double, radius: double) -> string =>
    if !within(x, y, 0.0D, radius) then
        " "
    elif within(x, y, -radius / 2.0D, radius / 6.0D) then
        "#"
    elif within(x, y, radius / 2.0D, radius / 6.0D) then
        "."
    elif within(x, y, -radius / 2.0D, radius / 2.0D) then
        "."
    elif within(x, y, radius / 2.0D, radius / 2.0D) then
        "#"
    elif x < 0.0D then
        "."
    else
        "#"
    fi

taijitu(radius: int) -> Pipe[string] is
    for row in -radius::radius do
        yield ((-2 * radius)::(2 * radius))
            |> map((column: int) =>
                symbol(cast(column) / 2.0D, cast(row),
                    cast(radius)))
            |> join("")
    od
si

[4, 8]
    |> each((radius: int) =>
        (taijitu(radius) |> each(line => write_line(line))
         write_line("")))
